paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy achieved on CUBE-easy with a Solution Validator across different rounds of conversation for two feedback types. The x-axis is labeled "Round of Conversation" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks displayed at intervals of 5, extending from 10 to 25. The line representing "Binary" feedback is a thick, solid golden-yellow line with circular markers. It begins at an accuracy of exactly 10 at round 1 and demonstrates a steady upward trend, passing through approximately 13 at round 2, 17 at round 3, 21 at round 4, and ending at 24 at round 5. The line representing "Detailed" feedback is a thick, solid light blue line with circular markers. It also begins at an accuracy of 10 at round 1, increases to 13 at round 2, rises to 21 at round 3, reaches 26 at round 4, and concludes its steady upward trend at 28 at round 5.
